title: Monaco Cancels Chelsea's Lamine Camara Transfer Amid Liverpool Involvement
summary: Monaco has cancelled the transfer of Lamine Camara to Chelsea, reportedly due to a call from Liverpool. Chelsea is described as furious over the last-minute collapse of the deal, which was valued at approximately £47 million. Monaco's chief reportedly made an "extraordinary accusation" related to the cancellation. There are also reports of a phone call between Xabi Alonso and Lamine Camara.
summary_points: Monaco cancelled the transfer of Lamine Camara to Chelsea.
Chelsea is reportedly furious about the deal's collapse.
A call from Liverpool to Monaco is cited as a reason for the cancellation.
The transfer was reportedly valued at around £47 million.
Monaco's chief allegedly made an "extraordinary accusation" regarding the deal.
